entry.title: Trump renames Lake Ontario as 'Lake America'
entry.summary: Donald Trump has renamed Lake Ontario to ‘Lake America’ following the recent failure of trade negotiations between USA and Canada.

entry.title: Fully autonomous drones have killed human soldiers for the first time
entry.summary: A military contractor named Alexander Kokhanovskyy has revealed that a test was conducted two years ago in which fully autonomous drones killed human soldiers.

entry.title: Rockstar Games employees have formed a union
entry.summary: Employees of Rockstar Games have announced their intent to form a union, to be called “Rockstar Game Workers Union”. It will be a subsidiary of the existing “Workers’ Union of Great Britain”.

entry.title: First Chinese-made EVs arrive in Canada under deal Carney struck with Xi
entry.summary: The first China-made electric vehicles have arrived in Canada following a recent tariff reduction deal. The shipment was mostly from Tesla’s Shanghai factory, with some Lotus branded vehicles as well.
